title: Volcanoes of the world
intro: 10 volcanoes of the world, one after another. Put your marker as near as you can; the nearer, the more points. The map shows coasts, rivers, lakes and borders, and you work inside this area.

rounds.name: Nosy Be
rounds.fact: Nosy Be is a volcano with a recorded summit elevation of 450 m in the source data. The data places it in Madagascar.
